title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The working parser pool finally has a test
summary: Yesterday's repair to the parsing threads was covered from every angle except the one that runs in production: a pool whose threads are alive.

highlights.title: No behaviour change
highlights.description: Had the repair broken the working path, parsing would have quietly fallen back to the main thread and no test would have said a word.

sections.heading: Internal
bullets: A real parse through a thread, twelve jobs sharing three threads, and a thread reused once the queue drains.
That last one matters: twelve jobs on three threads pass even when threads are never returned to the pool. Only the request after the queue empties reveals it.
